reviews.title: New best friend
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Nebula for a while now and honestly, it’s become one of my favorite apps. The design is super clean and easy to navigate, which makes the whole experience feel really smooth. I love how personalized everything feels—it’s like the app actually understands what I’m interested in.

The content is engaging and there’s always something new to explore, so it never gets boring. It’s also great for those moments when you just want to unwind or learn something interesting without putting in too much effort.

Overall, Nebula just feels thoughtfully made and genuinely enjoyable to use. Definitely worth checking out if you haven’t already!
reviews.reply:
Hi there,

Thank you for your feedback!

We’re really glad to hear you’ve been enjoying using Nebula and that the app feels easy to use, and tailored to your interests. It’s great to know the experience keeps you engaged with fresh content and offers a nice way to unwind or discover something new.

We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your thoughts. 

With gratitude for your journey,
Nebula Support Team 🔮

reviews.title: SCAM business practice is deceptive and breaches consumer trust
reviews.text:
I would like to report an issue with the website "Ask Nebula."
I accessed their service through an Facebook ad offering a quiz to discover my astrological card. The initial offer was to complete the quiz and pay $1 through Apple Pay, which I accepted. After paying the $1, I was directed to another page that advertised subscription services. I wanted to navigate away and simply view my quiz results without signing up for any subscription. However, without my permission and without the usual Face ID verification that Apple Pay normally requires, an $77.3 charge was processed through my Apple Pay account. I was not informed clearly that an $77.3 charge would be made, nor did I authorize it. There was no charge was processed through my Apple Pay account. I was not informed clearly that an $77.3 charge would be made, nor did I authorize it. There was no opportunity to confirm or cancel the transaction. When I tried to seek support, the only option available was sending a complaint and they refused to refund the money and instead offering me As an exception, you’re receiving a 50% refund, 150 credits, and two complimentary readings, making it impossible to properly address or resolve the issue. I’m not interested on any of these I want my money back is Xmas time and I need that money as is been designated to something else. THEY ARE SCAMMERS DO NOT USE THIS SERVICE OR APP. 
I believe this
business practice is deceptive and breaches consumer trust.
I am seeking a full refund and request that Consumer Affairs investigates this company for potential fraudulent behavior.
reviews.reply: Hi [Name], We’re truly sorry for the distress and frustration you’ve experienced. Clear communication is very important to us, and it’s upsetting to know you felt let down. We regret that our solution so far hasn’t provided the peace of mind you were hoping for. If you’d like to discuss your case further or need our help reviewing your account, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at support-appstore@asknebula.com. Your trust matters, and we want to address this directly, Nebula Team 🔮

reviews.title: Still Awaiting Refund
reviews.text: I ordered a reading for around $120. My question read - “My partner has been my rock since my Mum passed away and I want to know about our future health, kids and marriage. The reading response... Told me my partner is a bad match, there was absolutely nothing good said about us, everything was terrible - and we have a pretty awesome relationship... It also said my health is a concern, that I need to be careful; same with my partner. It was completely fear inducing, unethical and unprofessional of any Astrologist. I have sent two emails asking for a refund with no response - the astrologer who gave me the reading, responded, saying if I have questions... I could order them online - for more money. His profile is now removed from the App. I have many Mediums, Psychics and health care professionals as friends - to tell a person they will have health concerns; after they tell you their Mum has just passed... and then ask you for more money is completely criminal. It’s prying on the vulnerable for financial gain. Organise my refund immediately or I will take this further. Extremely disappointed and disgusted with this experience.
reviews.reply: Dear User, hello! Thanks for your time to leave a review. We are sorry for any confusion. You can tell us more about your problem and we will do our best to fix it. Please contact us at support@nebulahoroscope.com Kind regards, support team.

reviews.title: Charge me about 80$ with each month for no reason without subscribe
reviews.text:
I "purchased" a subscription with a 3 day free trial attached to it. When I went into my subscription management section on my phone to cancel before the trial ended the app was not listed at all in my subscription list. So I could not cancel it! I email developers immediately requesting cancellation. 3 days later I'm charged on my card and receive an email from developer advising it's out of their hands and to contact Apple. They said something about a lifetime access purchase dues not show up in your subscription section of your app management - which means they CANNOT OFFER a 3 day trial in that if that's the case. This is FALSE ADVERTISING! Do not click yes to the lifetime access with 3 day trial option! Apple have also rejected my request for a refund. I am furious!! To top it all off, I no longer have access to my premium features (nebula turned them off?) so I've been tricked into paying $80AUD for nothing!!
DO NOT buy this app - they cannot be trusted.
reviews.reply:
Hi dear user,
Thank you for feedback. We are very sorry to hear about your experience, and we understand your frustration.   
And we want you to feel confident and informed every step of the way. That’s why we clearly outline all the details about the service and any upcoming payments, if applicable, on the offer screen. We’re here to make things easy — so if anything isn’t clear, just let us know!
In addition, you can easily manage your subscription by following the simple steps in the Subscription Terms. Also, just keep in mind that deleting the app won’t automatically cancel your subscription since it is tied to the account subscriptions, not your phone storage.
If you are still seeking assistance, we are more than happy to help resolve the issue further. Please feel free to reach out to our team at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com for more support. Please note that we are always on the side of our users. 
Again, we regret the inconvenience, and we hope we can address the situation to your satisfaction.
Best regards, Nebula Team 🔮

Then you must confirm around 6 times that you actually want to cancel. You obviously have no faith in your own product since you feel the need to trap users in and make it so difficult to cancel.

Ridiculous.

Their emails look like spam, then they have the audacity to have a FAQ thread that says they email you 2 days before the free trial ends and if you don’t cancel the subscription you’ll be charged. LIKE I SAID - 1. I CANNOT FIND WHERE TO DO THIS ON THE WEBSITE WHATSOEVER AND 2. YOUR EMAILS LOOK LIKE SPAM. They have a ‘chat function’ where a bot replies to you with the option to be ‘transferred to an agent’ but then you’re prompted to leave your name and email so they can email you. WHY HAVE A CHAT FUNCTION??! TERRIBLE APP AND COMPLETE FRAUDS RIPPING PEOPLE OFF. AVOID!!!!

reviews.title: Very basic astrology, and my app doesn’t work any more
reviews.text:
If you are after some horoscopes for yourself throughout the year, and some key points about your own chart, then this app is fine. But you cannot upload or register the birth chart of others, just use a basic sun/rising analysis. If you want to learn astrology beyond basic horoscopes, this is not the best app. 
I was enjoying the monthly horoscopes, but they don’t work any more - even after deleting and updating the app, I cannot read anything except the daily horoscope. If I click to see tomorrow’s, the weekly or monthly forecast, all I can see is the daily. So if someone could fix that, awesome. Also, the nebula talk is just a bit of a waste of time, and there is no way I would pay money for a reading on this app having no idea where it is coming from.

The chart itself is great, lots of info and lays it out just fine for someone trying to deepen their astrology knowledge or start out, but no better than numerous other places that aren’t going to bombard you with people/bots (feels far too bot-vibed to me).

I deleted the app. Some time later (longer than a week) I received an email saying my 7 day trial was over and I was about to be charged $30 odd dollars, monthly. I was forced to scramble and try and work out how to cancel. More reading. It wasn’t easy and caused me stress and a lot of time. There was nowhere that said I was signing up for a subscription. This was not a fun experience.

There you will see a list of all active and expired subscriptions. When you tap on a subscription from the list, you can choose a different subscription option or tap Cancel Subscription. 
 
If you don’t see Cancel Subscription, the subscription is already canceled and won't renew.

Here's a more detailed guide on that from Apple: 
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

reviews.title: Beware – Unauthorized Charges & No Refund
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app expecting a one-time purchase, but instead I was charged $45 USD without my consent. I never agreed to any subscription, and the charge happened automatically.

When I contacted support, they admitted the subscription was canceled but refused to refund me, even though I reported it less than 24 hours after the charge. They told me my request “falls outside their refund policy”, which makes no sense, because REFUNDS are meant for after a charge has been made.

Instead of returning my money, they offered me “credits,” which I did not want or agree to. This is unacceptable and feels like a scam.

For comparison: I had the same issue with Hint.app, and the moment I requested a refund, they processed it immediately without any hassle. Nebula should be able to do the same.

Be very cautious with this app. Double-check everything and think twice before downloading.

reviews.title: Astrologer chat function is a money pit
reviews.text:
I decided to purchase the 14.99 credit for $22.99AUD to chat to an astrologer. This allowed me 5 mins of conversation, during which time the astrologer answered 1.5 questions.

If you are interested in improving, I could suggest having the app user select a set of filters before the chat timer starts (2.99/min). The options would be ‘area of reading interest’, i.e. career, money, love, travel; then perhaps ‘duration of interest’, i.e. short-term or long-term. I would ensure these selections are made before the timer starts and a short time is allotted for the astrologer to familiarise them self with the customer’s birth chart. This would ensure the customer gets more value out of their 5 mins, and therefore, are more likely to return for future chats.

I really think there needs to be more money value for that price. Especially considering the back and forth time delay between the customer and the astrologer during the chat.
